notes: The gain is entirely in learning behaviours. Every correctness assertion (explain the race, find item.product, FK vs reverse FK, at-least-once, zh-TW reply) passed in both configs: the baseline is technically excellent. Discriminating assertions: gap map, unknown-type tags, fundamentals flag, prediction checkpoint, withholding the fix.

Time is not like-for-like. With the skill the first turn stops at a checkpoint (213s mean); the baseline goes on to implement and verify (387s mean, with eval 4 at 871s because it ran a real Kafka). A full with-skill session spans several turns.

Weak spots even when passing: eval 2 decoded OOMKilled/137 itself before asking (the urgency rule pulls diagnosis forward); eval 3 named item.product outright instead of hinting; eval 1's first reply is ~6.4k chars, long for a minimum model.
n=1 per config, so there is no variance estimate. Treat the deltas as directional.
